description:
Stock trades reported by members of the U.S. House and Senate (STOCK Act Periodic Transaction Reports): member,
party, state, chamber, stock, purchase or sale, amount range, trade date, filing date, how many days late it was
reported, owner (self/spouse/joint/child) and a link to the official filing. With no filters: the week's summary,
most-traded stocks and late filers. FREE public information on every plan and never counted toward the daily limit.
Reports arrive up to 45 days after the trade (median about a month), so this is a historical record, not a live feed.
Use for 'which members of Congress traded NVDA?', 'what has Pelosi bought?', 'congressional trades this week'.
Must not be used for credit decisions, fundraising or solicitation.

days.title: Days
